scope: Warm in-process Searcher.search with real CPU query encoding, native Lance vector/FTS retrieval, fusion, candidate selection, reranking and response construction. Both arms use the current snapshot-bound row-ID Searcher, identical buffer-reusing decoding and one private store. Frozen immediately preceding optimized pairwise MaxSim versus current per-batch packed MaxSim.
limitations: Synthetic 96-document corpus on a shared host; no daemon/MCP/CLI or worker IPC, queueing, cold starts, indexing throughput or relevance/large-corpus claim. Small cached models only, copied into a disposable home. No production store or services touched.
